using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.client;
using Garnet.cluster.Server.Replication;
using Garnet.common;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Server.Replication.ReplicaOps.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaReceiveCheckpointTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync_LogsForegroundCheckpointRetrieval_WhenNotBackground()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            var options = new ReplicateSyncOptions
            {
                Background = false,
                UpgradeLock = false,
                NodeId = "test-node",
                TryAddReplica = false
            };

            var replicationManager = new TestReplicationManager(loggerMock.Object);
            var session = new Mock<ClusterSession>().Object;

            // Setup mocks to avoid real dependencies and let the method reach the log call
            replicationManager.SetupClusterProvider();

            // Act
            var result = await replicationManager.TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync(session, options);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>?>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Initiating foreground checkpoint retrieval")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestReplicationManager : ReplicationManager
        {
            private readonly Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>> _loggerMock;
            public Mock<IClusterProvider> ClusterProviderMock { get; }
            public Mock<IStoreWrapper> StoreWrapperMock { get; }

            public TestReplicationManager(Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>> loggerMock)
            {
                _loggerMock = loggerMock;
                ClusterProviderMock = new Mock<IClusterProvider>();
                StoreWrapperMock = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>();
                // Initialize other dependencies as needed for constructor
            }

            public void SetupClusterProvider()
            {
                // Mock dependencies to allow method execution without real cluster operations
                ClusterProviderMock.Setup(x => x.clusterManager).Returns(new Mock<IClusterManager>().Object);
                // Add other necessary mocks to prevent exceptions before reaching the log call
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class ReplicationManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync_LogsForegroundCheckpointRetrieval_WhenForeground()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            loggerMock.Setup(x => x.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);

            // Create options for foreground execution (Background = false)
            var options = new ReplicateSyncOptions 
            { 
                Background = false,
                TryAddReplica = false,
                NodeId = "test-node"
            };

            // Create a testable ReplicationManager that bypasses problematic dependencies
            var testManager = new TestableReplicationManager(loggerMock.Object);
            
            // Mock session to avoid session-related exceptions
            var sessionMock = new Mock<ClusterSession>();
            sessionMock.Setup(s => s.UnsafeBumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsync())
                      .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
            var session = sessionMock.Object;

            // Act
            var result = await testManager.TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync(session, options);

            // Assert - Verify the specific LogInformation call on line 63 was executed
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogInformation(
                    "Initiating foreground checkpoint retrieval"),
                Times.Once);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Testable subclass that overrides problematic dependencies to reach the log statement
        /// </summary>
        private class TestableReplicationManager : ReplicationManager
        {
            private readonly ILogger<ReplicationManager> _logger;

            public TestableReplicationManager(ILogger<ReplicationManager> logger)
            {
                _logger = logger;
            }

            // Override to provide null logger (avoids null ref)
            public new ILogger<ReplicationManager> logger => _logger;

            // Stub out clusterProvider to avoid real cluster operations
            protected new object clusterProvider => new MockClusterProvider();

            // Make internal fields accessible/protected for testing
            internal new object storeWrapper => null;
            internal new CancellationTokenSource resetHandler => null;

            private class MockClusterProvider 
            { 
                public MockClusterManager clusterManager { get; } = new();
            }

            private class MockClusterManager 
            { 
                public MockClusterConfig CurrentConfig { get; } = new();
            }

            private class MockClusterConfig 
            { 
                public string LocalNodeId => "test";
                public (string address, int port) GetLocalNodePrimaryAddress() => (null, -1);
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogInformation_CalledWithForegroundMessage_ExecutesSuccessfully()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerMock.Setup(x => x.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);
            var message = "Initiating foreground checkpoint retrieval";

            // Act
            loggerMock.Object.LogInformation(message);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>?>((v, t) => v.ToString() == message),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogInformation_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            ILogger logger = null;
            var message = "Initiating foreground checkpoint retrieval";

            // Act & Assert
            Assert.Same(logger, logger?.LogInformation(message));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogInformation_LoggerDisabled_DoesNotLog()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerMock.Setup(x => x.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(false);
            var message = "Initiating foreground checkpoint retrieval";

            // Act
            loggerMock.Object.LogInformation(message);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>>(),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Never);
        }
    }
}
